headline: Laya (open weights, Mac mini) and Jev (TypeSafe, hosted) graded 1,719 student answers, untrained on the data.
text: Laya (open weights, Mac mini) and Jev (TypeSafe, hosted) graded 1,719 student answers, untrained on the data. Alone: QWK 0.31 and 0.58 against a human 0.91. With a 70% confidence gate: 17% of answers at QWK 0.61, 37% at 0.77. The rest go to a teacher.
